emittedCssQualification.method: Parse emitted CSS AST. Exact selector/at-rule/declaration keys compared independent of chunk hash filenames; source descriptors/module comparison remain separate. Added/removed global utility rules are listed rather than presumed harmless.
emittedCssQualification.scopedDelta: Added rules cover order_* refinements and scoped cookie gold; root declaration change is removal of --tracking-normal. Removed utility definitions are associated with cart changes in the owner scope.
emittedCssQualification.cascadeQualification: The false aggregate-order flag compares lexicographically sorted chunk filenames, not route HTML stylesheet order. It is not itself proof of a route cascade regression or proof that the cascade is unchanged.
limitations: This AST delta is not a browser visual/contrast acceptance test.
Rule sequence is aggregated by lexicographically sorted chunk filenames, not route HTML stylesheet order; a sequence mismatch alone is not a cascade regression.
CSS cascade context and source/controller hashes must be reviewed with the actual added/removed selectors.
Dynamic class application and the new cart/photo behavior require owner compiled QA.
